scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:agent && npm run build:web && tsc
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/contracts/contracts.test.js dist/tests/data/query_engine.test.js dist/tests/e2e/dashboard_simulation.test.js dist/tests/interruption/stale_result_race.test.js dist/tests/interruption/stress.test.js dist/tests/interruption/telemetry.test.js dist/tests/interruption/turn_sequencing.test.js dist/tests/state/dashboard_state.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace=@voiceops/shared run test && npm --workspace=@voiceops/agent run test && npm run build && node --test dist/tests/data/query_engine.test.js dist/tests/state/dashboard_state.test.js
scripts.test:interruption: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/interruption/turn_sequencing.test.js dist/tests/interruption/stale_result_race.test.js dist/tests/interruption/telemetry.test.js dist/tests/interruption/stress.test.js
